body:
I consider myself well acquainted with trypts and phens like LSD, Psilocybin, mescaline, DMT both orally and vaporized with and without the addition of harmalas, 2cp, 2cd, 25cnbome hcl, 4-ho-met, and 4-ho-mipt. I also have experienced methoxetamine, 3-meo-pcp, ketamine and various opiates. I did an allergy test with 5mgs of Ally the night prior and had no bad reactions so I was ready to give this chem a shot!
I dosed at 2:40 pm while home alone. Its a beautiful day outside and looks to be a promising day as far as weather is concerned. I don't have any commitments or plans for the day and I'm in a great mental space right now as I'm on a bit of a vacation from corporate hell where I worked for 10 years.  I've been using this time to make plans for the future and to transition from the horrible depressive mind state that I was in at  my job to a completely renewed/rejuvenated self that is excited about what the future holds!
Anyways, I received a 250mg sample of Allylescaline from my trusty supplier. It is a light tan powder with a very shiny/crystalline look to it.  It reminded me of sparkly harmalas to an extent. I should also mention that I had eaten a meal a couple hours prior to dosing and I did have a very small amount of Suboxone in my system. (I had taken half of an 8mg strip each day for the prior 3 days). There did not seem to be any contraindications in my research and therefore took 27mgs as suggested by Shulgin.  I had been watching youtube documentaries about ancient civilizations earlier in the day and thus continued during the come up phase of the experience.
(All chems/dosages were taken via ORAL ROA)
1 hr - I'm starting to feel that familiar warm feeling that I've perceived with cacti. Nothing major but a slight energy increase.  I'm already a major leg bouncer and I've  noticed my legs bouncing even more than usual.  Typical side effect of any stimulant use that I've experienced.
1:30 hr - Not much of a change.  Decided at this point to take an additional 25mgs and get myself up to the dosage range that I've been seeing in the few reports available. I've read a few reports of gradually stepping up the dosage as with mescaline in order to reach the desired level. I'm feeling great and relatively clear-headed at this point but would like to  reach a more psychedelic effect level.  I am going to smoke some of this lovely blue cheese that I have at the moment and see how I feel.
2:30 hr - definitely feeling it more at this point.  Warm, stoney, very slightly psychedelic. Nothing major to report.  No OEV/CEV to speak of.  I've been taking bong hits of blue cheese from time to time. No noticeable synchronicity between the two but I can definitely feel a difference between the THC and ally as I smoke more.
Nothing more really happened after this.  It was a slightly stimulating chemical that just made it over the threshold of being psychedelic at the 52mg dosage that I ended up taking. It was almost like a threshold dose of LSD with a slightly more 'mescaline' feeling to it if that makes any sense. I also feel I should mention that I DID NOT experience any nausea whatsoever during the entire experience.
4 hrs - I decided that the experience was not going to develop any further on its own so I took 35mgs of miprocin. (4-ho-mipt) It is a nice off-white colored powder. Nothing special about the appearance.
5 hrs - Once the miprocin started kicking in I was really starting to feel good. It seemed like quite the symbiosis at that point. Probably most likely due to the miprocin but I was on an incredible spiritual high! The little lift of energy from the ally complimented the nice smooth psilocin-like effects very well!  I felt like rocky balboa jogging up the stairway to heaven!  Ready to take on the world!  I started having light tracers and threshold level textural changes. The stars looked incredible!  I walked to CVS a couple blocks over for a pack of smokes somewhere around 3am and was amazed at how everything seemed to 'pop' with interest.  I live right by a hospital and thus the area is well lighted in the evening.  It did not seem overly bright/glaring at this level and was quite easy to communicate.  Unfortunately the lady at CVS could not communicate herself.... She wheezed her way up to the counter and literally couldn't do anything but whisper to me in order to talk.  While I found this highly bizarre in my wonkified state, I just kept it moving.
I lost track of time after that but when I got home I took a small dose of MXE (50mgs) to top off what had been an incredible evening.  I never really felt it kick in over the miprocin but then all of the sudden I found myself having a conversation with myself about how hilarious life is.  I was having a great time just laughing at the entire thought of human beings and me being stuck inside of this weird body. I also started having an MXE breakthrough (as I call it), where all of the sudden I'm able to look at something that has been right in front of my face for a long time, but in a totally different light, which made me extremely happy at the time! I ended up pulling up my personal discography of songs that I've composed/recorded over the last 15 years and listened to them until around 6am before finally falling asleep. The last couple hours of this experience I was dancing around my house like a madman and having a wonderful time. I felt so good about myself as a person, and about the opportunities that are coming up in my life!  I did notice some colorful CEV's between 4-6am. There was no patterning or anything, just swashes of warm flowy colors that oscillated in sync with the tunes.
Overall it was a great experience. I will definitely be doing more experimentation with Ally at a slightly higher dose. I'm not sure if that will make the experience stronger/more psychedelic but I definitely am not ready to set Ms. Ally aside as she seems to have potential!
